It’s still decent in October if you want to take advantage of some cool dolphin fishing in the fall.. Book Now to secure your spot on Sea Teaser. Various baits can be used. Artificial Lures including offshore trolling lures, as well as ballyhoo, squid, and cut bait. Dolphin are found offshore. blurb: Guests fish inshore, nearshore, and offshore waters around Virginia Beach targeting species like speckled trout, red drum, black drum, striped bass, and more. The fleet includes a 36' boat "M/T POCKETS" and a 42' boat "SEA TEASER" equipped with fishing gear, safety equipment, and comfort amenities. Trips range from 3/4 day nearshore to full day offshore fishing.
